caption: This shoyu ramen boasts a rich, amber broth, topped with tender chashu, crisp menma, and a single nori sheet. Served in a blue-patterned bowl, it rests on a warm wooden table under soft, inviting light.

segments_info.text: Wooden table surface shows warm brown tones, smooth grain patterns, and subtle light reflections.
Chashu pork slice shows pinkish meat with crispy, caramelized browned edges and a slightly uneven, tender surface.
The nori seaweed is dark green, textured, rectangular, with slightly curled edges and visible surface veins.
The shoyu (soy sauce) broth is amber-brown, glossy, and rich, cradling noodles and toppings in a smooth, slightly viscous surface.
Menma bamboo shoots appear as pale orange, slightly translucent, segmented pieces with a glossy surface.
The ceramic bowl is cream-colored with blue floral patterns and a smooth, slightly glossy rim.
